metadata.title: COSU Lecture Capture Console SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Lecture Capture Consoles as purpose-bound endpoint execution environments for classroom recording and presentation control.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to lecture recording, audiovisual control, and presentation capture functions in instructional spaces.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Lecture Capture Consoles inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint dedicated to lecture capture and audiovisual control.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved lecture capture, presentation, and audiovisual control applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Usage is shared among instructors or operators via role-based or session-based access without persistent local profiles.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Lecture Capture Consoles are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Lecture Capture Consoles are centrally enrolled, managed, and monitored.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management, integrity, and service trust, not for user or data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, general productivity software, removable media, and unauthorized interfaces.

props.name: anti-tamper-controls
props.remarks: Controls prevent application switching, unauthorized software installation, and runtime manipulation of capture workflows.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is restricted to approved lecture capture platforms, streaming endpoints, storage destinations, and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local data persistence is permitted only as required for buffering or capture workflows and is cleared automatically.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Lecture Capture Consoles may participate only in workflows involving public or minimally sensitive instructional data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Instructional recording functionality does not imply eligibility for higher-classification institutional data.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Lecture Capture Consoles must prioritize availability and rapid recovery to support scheduled instructional activities.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Console health, capture service status, and integrity events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Lecture Capture Consoles support rapid reset, automated reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Lecture Capture Consoles implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on availability, functional integrity, and constrained data handling.

roles.title: Classroom Technology Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration, monitoring, and availability of Lecture Capture Consoles.

roles.title: Instructional Technology Governance
roles.remarks: Approves capture platforms, data flows, and exception handling for Lecture Capture Consoles.

control-implementation.remarks: Lecture Capture Console implementations are platform-specific (Windows, Linux, or embedded OS) and maintained as controlled configuration baselines aligned with this SSPP.
